Name: Stardew Dashboard - Live HUD and Info Tracker
Author: RuthlessTex
Description:
[center][size=5][b][color=#f0c858]You've been farming for three hours and you have no idea where you stand.[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d4]How many bundles are left? Did you pet your animals? Where are the missing Golden Walnuts?
It's all in the game, buried across a dozen menus. [b][color=#f0c858]Not anymore.[/color][/b][/color][/center]

[center][img width=500,height=250]https://i.ibb.co/KpfWbn3K/V2-0-0-Menu-Display.gif[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#7ec850]✅ FULLY COMPATIBLE WITH STARDEW VALLEY 1.6[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][color=#f0c858][b]⭐ I built this to win the A Decade in the Valley contest.
If this mod saves you an Alt-Tab to the Wiki, please endorse it![/b][/color][/center]

[size=4][b][color=#7ec850]快速开始 / GETTING STARTED[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Press F10[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Open the full Dashboard to see a "Quick Summary" snapshot of your entire farm.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Live HUD Overlay[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Right-click any line in the Dashboard to pin it to your screen.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]v2.1.5[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: View missing crafting & cooking recipes and Books of Power progress. Built-in Fishing Guide with locations and catch times. Track Mastery XP, upcoming birthdays, daily hay consumption, and sort Friendships by name, hearts, or gifts (change via `config.json` or GMCM).[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b][color=#7ec850]核心功能 / CORE FEATURES[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d4]Hitting Perfection means tracking dozens of things at once. Stardew Dashboard puts everything one keypress away, designed to feel native to the game.[/color]

[list]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Perfection & Endgame Tracking[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Track your Museum (Missing Pieces), Full Shipment, Polyculture, Community Centre room-by-room status, Ginger Island unlocks, Golden Walnuts, Books of Power, Craft Master, and Gourmet Chef - all with progress bars and mod-aware recipe support.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Live HUD Tracking[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Right-click any line to pin it to your screen. Quests, Skill XP, Luck, Machine counts — Museum, Shipping & Polyculture collapse into a single tidy card.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Smart Fishing Guide[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Stop checking the Wiki. Includes total catch stats, a Legendary Fish checklist (uncaught only), and a full fish location guide with seasons, weather, time windows, and caught/uncaught status - including modded fish.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Ready to Collect[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: See every machine, artisan good, and crop ready to harvest across your entire farm - grouped by location with time-until-ready countdowns. Fish Ponds now show produce ready to collect and active population quests.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]NPC Gift Guide[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Heart levels, gift status, birthday tags, and the top 3 Likes/Dislikes for every villager - including custom NPCs from SVE and Ridgeside Village. Upcoming birthdays are flagged in the Quick Summary too.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Farm Animals & Buildings[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: All adopted pets listed individually with name, bond level, and mood. Per-animal livestock detail with portraits, mood, friendship rating, and petting reminders. Hay stock with daily consumption rate. Full building roster with under-construction status.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Skill Levels & Equipment[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Progress bars for all five skills plus exact XP-to-next-level tracking. Once all skills hit 10, replaced with a unified gold Mastery XP bar. See your currently equipped hat, rings, boots, and clothing at a glance.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Discovered Stats[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Auto-discovers and displays every stat the game tracks — Agriculture, Crafting, Mining, Combat, and even future modded stats — without needing updates.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Search & Export[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Diacritic-insensitive live search (with Ctrl+V support), smart grouping, and text-summary exports for planning.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b][color=#7ec850]兼容性 / COMPATIBILITY[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Configurable[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Fully supports [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] so you can change hotkeys and HUD settings in-game without touching files. Friendship sorting is configurable — choose one of: "Alphabetical" (default), "LowestHearts", "HighestHearts", "GiftsThisWeek", or "GiftedTodayFirst" via `config.json` or GMCM (localized names shown in-game).[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]UI Recolors[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Uses native assets to automatically match Vintage, Starblue, Earthy, etc.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Portraiture[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Full support for high-res and season-specific custom portraits in the Dashboard and Live HUD.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Expansions[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Fully supports SVE, Ridgeside Village, and custom NPC mods.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]HUD Mods[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: 100% compatible with UI Info Suite 2 (use that for micro, this for macro).[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#f0c858]Multiplayer[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Safe for co-op with global config.json settings for easy sharing.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[center][size=4][b][color=#7ec850]TACO FUND[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d4]Keeping this optimized and "Wiki-free" takes a lot of time and a suspicious amount of tacos. If this makes your farm life easier and you want to keep the updates flowing while I shove my face full of carnitas, feel free to toss a taco my way. No pressure.[/color][/center]
[center][url=https://ko-fi.com/ruthlesstex][b][color=#f0c858]TOSS A TACO TO THE DEVELOPER (KO-FI)[/color][/b][/url][/center]

[size=4][b][color=#7ec850]技术细节 / TECHNICAL[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b][color=#6ab8e8]Install[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Drop StardewDashboard into your Mods folder. Requires[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0+[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#6ab8e8]Localization[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Fully translated into 11 languages (EN, DE, ES, FR, IT, JA, KO, PT-BR, RU, TR, ZH).[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#6ab8e8]Developers[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Inject your own sections via our API (see Developer-API docs).[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#6ab8e8]Safety[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d4]: Read-only. This mod never touches your save file.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[center][size=3][b][color=#f0c858]Stop guessing. Start knowing.[/color][/b][/size][/center]

Manifest.Name: Stardew Dashboard
Manifest.Description: Press F10 for a full dashboard — skills & XP, friendships with portraits, quests, Community Centre, Museum, Full Shipment & Polyculture trackers, weather, animals, artisan goods, farming, fishing, mining, combat, and more. Pin any stat to the Live HUD. Smart search included. Extensible via mod API. Read-only, no setup, multiplayer-safe.
